title: A Missed Train Home
sentences: Jack was late for work this morning.
He ran to the station but missed his train.
The next train was not coming for a while.
He decided to take a bus instead.
The bus was slow because of heavy traffic.
Jack felt worried, so he called his manager.
His manager told him not to worry about it.
Jack finally arrived at work a little late.
That evening, he learned to check the train times.
Now he always leaves home earlier than before.
